content.comment_body: Hello, Can you explain how this works with [product_name]? Does the microSD card need to be formatted and completely empty? Is there any configuration needed to enable logging to it? Also, is it necessary to use a separate asynchronous pulse generator before the data logger to achieve regular, periodic recording? Thanks.
The microSD card should be formatted in FAT32. If you want to enable periodic data recording, you need to control the Data Log using a pulse generator (refer to the attached file).

Hi, Have you checked the manual? For [product_name], you can store up to 20,000 records per datalog on the memory card. Once a record is full, the system will automatically start a new one, up to 50 times. Note that through [product_name_software], you can only upload the latest record. To access older records, you need to connect the memory card to your PC and copy the data. Hope this clarifies things.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are asking for instructions on how to use the data logging feature with [product_name], especially concerning writing logs to a microSD card. There is some uncertainty about how to prepare the card, configuration steps for enabling periodic data capture, and methods for accessing stored logs. Responses provide information about memory card formatting, controlling log cycles, and limitations in retrieving certain records directly from the device.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple, clear workflow for enabling periodic data logging to a microSD card in [product_name], including guidance on setup steps and easy access to the logged information.
